name: Apportation
body:
You can force the power of teleportation spells to fuel a natural teleportation ability.

Prerequisites: Iron Will, Spell Focus (conjuration), able to cast a conjuration (teleportation) spell.

Benefit: You gain apportation, a spell-like teleportation ability. You may spend a prepared conjuration (teleportation) spell to fuel this ability, or use a spell slot to fuel it if you are a spontaneous spellcaster who knows a conjuration (teleportation) spell. You may use this ability once per level of the spell or spell slot spent to fuel it. You may never have more uses of apportation available at once than half your hit dice, and you lose one use of apportation for each hour that passes without using it.

Apportation is a standard action and acts as a dimension door, with a caster level equal to half your hit dice and a maximum range of 5 feet per hit die.
